functional_geometry.solid: one watertight, winding-consistent, edge-connected positive-volume solid

hard_constraints: Produce the required STL as one watertight, winding-consistent, edge-connected positive-volume solid rather than only reporting metrics.
Stay inside the stated coordinate envelope and above the minimum useful spans.
Stay within the stated material-volume range.
Retain the quantified continuous z=0 base contact and separated ventilating rail/slat geometry at the z=10 mm probe.
Use only the supplied task inputs; do not use evaluator-generated artifacts or evaluator implementation files.
invalid_conditions: Missing, unparsable, empty, or implausibly small STL geometry.
Bounding-box, coordinate-envelope, volume, solid-validity, base-contact, slat-count, thickness, gap, or ventilation-openness violation.
Native project files used as the only deliverable.
metric: surface_area/volume with a low-height penalty; thin ventilated shields score higher than tall blocks
objective: Maximize surface density for a low-profile ventilated shield while penalizing unnecessary height.
